title: orchestrator + agentRunStore needs to be improved
description:
`orchestrator` and `agentRunStore` needs to work similarly to how ProjectTools or StoryTools work in terms of the API, subscribing and propagating changes - there's a FilesWatcher observing changes to the files that are involved and whenever there's a change there - then the subscribers get notified.
There's no need to have the emitter (i.e. emit inside runAgentOnStory or runAgentOnFeature) - the client should just initiate a run, this library stores all the necessary data, and then the client listens to updates via agentRunStore's subscribe api. It should be possible to cancel a running agent via a single API. Thus, agentRunStore should be merged with the orchestrator - creating a single AgentTools.

features.title: Refactor the orchestrator to use AgentRunTools better
features.description: @src/orchestrator.ts needs to be refactored as it's extremely hard to read. It needs to push updates to the @src/agents/AgentRunTools.ts  via an interface - there shouldn't be any of the 'emit' functionality as it makes the code bulky and hard to read.
